task.question: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
task.evidence: Spain have been crowned FIFA World Cup 2026™ winners following their 1-0 victory over Argentina after extra-time in the final at New York New Jersey Stadium.

answer:
The 2026 FIFA World Cup has not yet taken place, as it is scheduled to happen in June and July 2026. Therefore, there is currently no winner. 

FINAL: Not yet determined.
